drbd-reactorctl-evict 
Evict a promoter plugin controlled resource

USAGE:
    drbd-reactorctl evict [FLAGS] [OPTIONS] [--] [configs]...

FLAGS:
    -f, --force          
            Override checks (multiple plugins per snippet/multiple resources per promoter)

    -h, --help           
            Prints help information

    -k, --keep-masked    
            If set the target unit will stay masked (i.e., 'systemctl mask --runtime')

    -u, --unmask         
            If set unmask targets (i.e. the equivalent of 'systemctl unmask').
            This does not run any evictions.
            It is used to clear previous '--keep-masked' operations

OPTIONS:
        --context <context>    
            Uses the given (cluster) context [default: default]

    -d, --delay <delay>        
            Positive number of seconds to wait for peer takeover [default: 20]

        --nodes <nodes>...     
            Uses only the given nodes from the context [default: ]


ARGS:
    <configs>...    
            Configs to remove
